library.description: Asynchronous runtime-neutral logging host with composable delivery features.

blocks.text: 异步日志 host。日志调用同步返回，条目随后按顺序经过异步管线与输出策略。控制台、HTTP、文件、进程收尾、reasoning 和持久日志由独立插件提供。

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** host 拥有插件安装、日志交付与最终释放。 */
const log = createLogHost({ plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()] })
log.info('request completed', { requestId: 'r1' })
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: `info()` 返回时输出尚未开始。`flush()` 等待已接纳的条目、异步交付与插件缓冲区；默认等待预算为 3000 毫秒。`shutdown()` 先运行最后日志处理器，再停止准入、排空并释放插件。并发 shutdown 返回同一个 Promise。
内置 feature：`thresholdFeature`、`filterFeature`、`uuidFeature`、`formatFeature`、`batchFeature`、`retryFeature`、`timeoutFeature`。支持汇总入口 `./features` 和各自的默认导出，例如 `./features/retry`。

feature 工厂返回 `@migaia/plugin-host` 的原生 opaque 定义，不暴露 descriptor 字段或控制方法。`defineLogPlugin` 基于 `definePlugin` 组装普通 host-wide 插件；`createLogHost` 只通过 `plugins` 接收策略。`features` 一律使用 `{ alias: feature }` record。每次插件安装独立创建状态，控制通过 `${pluginName}_${alias}_${method}` 扩展调用，例如 `log.policy_threshold_setLevel('warn')`。

输出插件的 features 只作用于自身。同 key 的输出级 feature 覆盖 host-wide feature；format、batch、retry、timeout 这四类每个输出只取一个，输出自己配了哪一类，就替换 host-wide 的同类 feature（即使 key 不同）。不同 key 的 gate 都会执行，即使来自同一工厂。一个插件的 record 里同类 format/batch/retry/timeout 只能有一个；多个 host-wide carrier 不能声明同 key，也不能各自提供同一类 format/batch/retry/timeout，违反时以既有 `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。执行按 entry、gate、format、batch、retry、timeout、输出阶段组织，gate 保留有效 record 声明顺序。没有有效显式 format 时才采用输出默认格式。
输出可声明 `consumesText: false`，只接收原条目与取消信号，跳过 host 格式阶段；该输出不能配置 format 或 defaultFormat。条目处理、gate 与交付策略照常执行。

items: 日志方法不抛出运行期交付错误；`flush()` 与 `shutdown()` 总是兑现。失败通过 `onFailure()` 观察；没有监听器时交给 `report`。
监听器失败以 `HOOK_FAILED` 交给 reporter，原错误保留在 `cause`。reporter 自身失败会被收住，不递归报告。
非法创建配置同步抛带 `source`、`code` 的错误。`use()`、`unUse()` 是配置操作，可以拒绝。
durable 的 append、commit、read 与失效句柄仍按存储契约拒绝；日志的非 throw 保证不覆盖事务操作。
待处理条目默认上限 10000，超出时丢弃最旧的未处理条目并报告 `QUEUE_OVERFLOW`。

import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** 每个 host 独立拥有上下文、插件与交付队列。 */

注入的调度器必须在 `schedule()` 返回 receipt 后才运行 callback；返回之前同步调用 callback 不在支持范围内。
host 门面被冻结。`ctx` 的顶层容器、上下文路径与环境标记也被冻结；嵌套用户值与 Date 保留身份，不做深克隆。`dispatchRaw()` 同步复制输入条目的顶层数组与对象，忽略输入 id，生成自己的条目 id。输出端各自收到浅快照；原生 Error 与嵌套业务对象保持身份。
`levelPlugin()` 添加 `debug`、`info`、`warn`、`error`、`fatal` 与 `atLevel`。字符串首参作为 message，其余参数保留原生类型；非字符串首参进入 args。插件本身不做过滤。
门槛只解释标准级别；普通未知 tag 跳过级别比较，仍经过过滤。`atLevel()` 保留业务 tag，并携带其标准级别供门槛解释。UUID 总是写入 `data.uuid`，`display` 只控制 `data.uuidDisplay`，不关闭生成。
entry 在 host 入口执行一次；每个输出端随后按 gate、format、batch、retry、timeout、实际输出的阶段顺序交付。同一 gate 阶段保留有效 record 的声明顺序，不用工厂类别决定名称或覆盖。

`defineLogPlugin({ name, features })` 通过原生 `definePlugin` 安装 host-wide 策略。`createLogHost` 没有 `features` 选项；所有策略随调用者声明的插件进入。`defineOutputPlugin` 的策略只作用于自己的输出。两者一律使用 `{ alias: feature }` record，保留属性声明顺序。

record key 是 feature 的名称：输出级 `features.<key>` 覆盖 host-wide 同 key 的 feature。不同 key 即使使用同一工厂也都保留，例如 `{ a: thresholdFeature(), b: thresholdFeature() }` 会应用两个 gate。未覆盖的 host gate 先运行，输出级 gate 随后按声明顺序运行。entry feature 只允许装在 host-wide carrier。

format、batch、retry、timeout 每个输出只取一个：输出自己配了其中哪一类，就替换 host-wide 的同类 feature，key 不同也一样。一个插件的 record 里每类最多一个，在安装插件时检查（`createLogHost` 或 `use()`）；多个 host-wide carrier 不能声明同 key，也不能各自提供同一类，动态 `use()` 同样检查。违反时以既有 `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。没有有效显式 format 时采用输出插件的 `defaultFormat`。

blocks.text: batch 默认 `maxSize: 20`、`maxWaitMs: 2000`、`maxConcurrentBatches: 1`、`maxPendingBatches: 1024`、`drainTimeoutMs: 3000`。容量同时计入排队和执行中的批次；满时丢弃最旧的排队批次，若所有槽位都在执行中则丢弃传入批次，并报告带 `detail.dropped` 的 `BATCH_OVERFLOW`。移除输出插件时先排空最后缓冲，再撤销交付所用的注册 signal。
retry 的 `attempts` 必须显式给出正安全整数；`backoff` 可为毫秒数或接收失败尝试序号的函数。输出端的 `retryable` 决定是否继续；`retryDelay` 的值经 `beforeRetry` 接入，并优先于普通 backoff。超时通过失败通道报告 `DELIVERY_FAILED`，原始 utils 超时错误保留在 `cause`。
交付失败且 timeout 清理也失败时，`retryable` 与 `retryDelay` 收到原始交付错误。清理错误在原聚合中依次跟在主错误后，该聚合保留在 `logging / DELIVERY_FAILED` 包装的 `cause`。交付成功后的清理失败只报告一次，经相同 host 错误边界离开，不重发已成功的操作。

`deliver` 接收 `readonly ILogOutputRecord[]` 和只读 `{ signal, format }`。record 同时包含原生 `entry` 与已选格式的 `text`。`context.format` 是实际安装后的 formatter implementation，不是冷 feature token；通过其格式函数或可选 pretty 渲染能力观察行为，不比较 token 身份。

不消费文本的输出声明 `consumesText: false` 并省略 `defaultFormat`。其回调收到只含 `entry` 的 record 与只含 `signal` 的 context；host 跳过该输出的格式阶段，输出级配置任何 format 都在安装该输出时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。entry、gate、批量、重试与超时照常执行。省略 consumesText 则保留原文本回调类型与必填 defaultFormat。

`defineLogPlugin` 与 `defineOutputPlugin` 都在真实 native `features` record 中声明 feature；可选 `install(core)` 通过 `core.features[alias]` 读取原生安装输出并返回扩展。host 与动态 use 句柄保留扩展的精确类型。filter/threshold 的控制自动以 `${pluginName}_${alias}_${method}` 命名暴露，完整扩展重名由 plugin-host 拒绝。复用同一 token 不会共享不同插件或 host 的可变状态；一个 carrier 的控制会影响所有继承其默认策略的输出。插件 core 提供安装期资源登记、scoped config、lifecycle、scheduler、sink、failure、defer、flush 与 shutdown 能力；资源通过真实 plugin-host 生命周期回滚与释放。

第三方使用 `defineLogFeature()`，完整实现 entry、gate 或 format 中一种，例如 `defineLogFeature({ phase: 'gate', accept: () => true })`；delivery 只由内置 batch/retry/timeout 工厂提供。所有工厂返回真实 `defineFeature` 原生 opaque token，不带 phase、stage、setLevel 或 add 字段。定义不接受名称字段，名称仅来自 record key。phase 与内置交付策略从每个 feature 的安装输出读取，所以 phase 与作用域规则在安装声明它的插件时检查；状态和控制由原生 install 输出拥有。普通字面量、浅复制和类型断言都不能制造 plugin-host 身份。

`projectLogEntry(entry)` 是共享结构化投影。它只把 error 替换为 utils `serializeErrorChain(entry.error.raw)`；保留 source、code、name、message、stack、cause 与 aggregate 分支，排除 raw 的自有私有字段。JSON 格式与 HTTP envelope 共用该投影，原始 entry.error.raw 不变。
日志方法与 flush/shutdown 的运行期错误不会进入业务控制流；创建配置错误与 use/unUse 的配置拒绝仍可离开调用边界。没有失败监听器时直接调用 reporter；监听器失败产生 `HOOK_FAILED`，原异常在 cause。reporter 自身抛错、then getter 失败或拒绝均被收住，终端失败不再递归上报。
`flush()` 的 3000 毫秒默认预算不证明所有日志已经送达。到期报告 `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` 并兑现；未完成工作的晚到拒绝仍被观察。shutdown 共享同一个 Promise，保留第一个 reason，先运行允许写最后日志的处理器，再关闭准入并释放插件。释放结果中的 `cleanupErrors` 必须由业务按需要检查。
`forwardPlugin({ targets })` 把当前 host 处理后的逻辑条目转交给目标 host，目标自己的管线与策略仍然执行。安装时拒绝自身与多跳环，分别使用 `FORWARD_SELF`、`FORWARD_CYCLE`。源 host 的 flush 包含目标的异步工作。
`use(...plugins)` 返回按输入顺序排列的真实 plugin-host 句柄元组；原变量的静态类型不会因动态安装而增加方法。`unUse(name)` 返回 peer 的 removal 结果，重复移除不存在插件会拒绝。撤销 forward 插件移除其边；源 shutdown 不关闭目标 host。

An asynchronous logging host. Log calls return synchronously; entries then pass through an ordered asynchronous pipeline and output policies. Separate plugins provide console, HTTP, file, process shutdown, reasoning and durable logging.

blocks.code:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** The host owns plugin installation, delivery and terminal cleanup. */
const log = createLogHost({ plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()] })
log.info('request completed', { requestId: 'r1' })
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: Output has not started when `info()` returns. `flush()` drains admitted entries, tracked asynchronous work and plugin buffers within a default 3000 ms wait budget. `shutdown()` runs final-log handlers, closes admission, drains and releases plugins. Concurrent shutdown calls share the same Promise.

Built-ins are `thresholdFeature`, `filterFeature`, `uuidFeature`, `formatFeature`, `batchFeature`, `retryFeature` and `timeoutFeature`. Import them together from `./features` or use individual default exports such as `./features/retry`.

Feature factories return opaque native `@migaia/plugin-host` definitions without descriptor fields or controls. `defineLogPlugin` uses `definePlugin` to assemble an ordinary host-wide plugin; `createLogHost` receives policies only through `plugins`. Every `features` declaration uses a `{ alias: feature }` record. Each plugin installation owns independent state. Controls are plugin extensions named `${pluginName}_${alias}_${method}`, for example `log.policy_threshold_setLevel('warn')`.

Features on an output plugin apply only to that output. An output feature replaces the host-wide feature with the same key, and an output that configures its own format, batch, retry or timeout replaces the host-wide one of that kind even under a different key. Gates under different keys both execute, including two instances of the same factory. One plugin record holds at most one format, batch, retry and timeout; host-wide carriers cannot share a key or each supply the same one of those four kinds. Duplicate host aliases and invalid individual records retain `logging / INVALID_OPTION`; two global carriers contributing the same singular format, batch, retry or timeout role fail with `plugin.host / FEATURE_ROLE_CONFLICT`. Execution follows entry, gate, format, batch, retry, timeout and transport phases, retaining effective record order within the gate phase. The output default format applies only when no explicit format survives.

An output can declare `consumesText: false` to receive entries and a cancellation signal while skipping host formatting. It cannot configure a format or defaultFormat. Entry processing, gates and delivery policies still apply.

items: Log methods contain runtime delivery errors. `flush()` and `shutdown()` always fulfill. Observe failures with `onFailure()`; otherwise the host calls `report`.
Listener failures reach the reporter as `HOOK_FAILED`, with the original on `cause`. Reporter failures are contained without recursive reporting.
Invalid creation options throw identified errors synchronously. Configuration operations `use()` and `unUse()` may reject.
Durable append, commit, read and invalid-handle operations keep their storage rejection contract. The logging guarantee does not mask transaction failures.
The default pending-entry capacity is 10000. Overflow drops the oldest unprocessed entry and reports `QUEUE_OVERFLOW`.

blocks.text: The host includes no output transport or third-party runtime dependency. It uses `@migaia/plugin-host`, `@migaia/middleware-pipeline`, `@migaia/lifecycle`, `@migaia/event-subscriber` and `@migaia/utils`.
See USEGUIDE.en.md for complete usage.

Output feature selections accept `false` to disable an inherited role. A local singular format, batch, retry or timeout replaces that whole inherited role; entry and gate selections replace the matching alias. Host defaults are published through the shared overlay and propagated to installed outputs on committed policy installation or removal.

blocks.text: Options are `plugins`, `context`, `topic`, `maxPending`, `scheduler`, `randomUUID`, `report` and plugin-host `execution`. The scheduler defaults to utils `systemScheduler`; UUID generation defaults to `globalThis.crypto.randomUUID()`. Both may be injected per host.
An injected scheduler must run callbacks after `schedule()` returns its receipt. Callbacks invoked synchronously before the receipt is returned are unsupported.

The host facade and top-level context containers are frozen. Nested user values and Date instances retain identity. `dispatchRaw()` captures shallow input containers synchronously and generates its own id. Each output receives a shallow snapshot; native errors and nested business objects retain their identities.
`levelPlugin()` adds `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, `fatal` and `atLevel`. A string first argument becomes message; other values remain native args. The plugin performs no filtering itself.

Unknown tags bypass only the standard level threshold. `atLevel()` keeps the business tag while supplying an explicit standard level. UUID enrichment always writes `data.uuid`; display controls only `data.uuidDisplay`.

Entry features execute once at host ingress. Each output then follows gate, format, batch, retry, timeout and transport phases, retaining effective record declaration order within the gate phase. `defineLogPlugin({ name, features })` installs host-wide policy through native `definePlugin`. `createLogHost` has no `features` option; policies arrive through caller-declared plugins. `defineOutputPlugin` policies apply only to their own output. Both use `{ alias: feature }` records in property declaration order. The record key is the feature name: output `features.<key>` overrides the same host-wide key. Different keys retain both features even when they use the same factory; `{ a: thresholdFeature(), b: thresholdFeature() }` applies both gates. Surviving host gates precede local gates in declaration order. Entry features belong only to host-wide carriers.

Each output applies at most one format, batch, retry and timeout. When an output configures one of these itself, it replaces the host-wide one of the same kind, even under a different key. One plugin record holds at most one of each, checked when the plugin is installed (`createLogHost` or `use()`). Host-wide carriers cannot share a key or each supply the same kind, including during dynamic `use()`. Duplicate host aliases and invalid individual records retain `logging / INVALID_OPTION`; two global carriers contributing the same singular format, batch, retry or timeout role fail with `plugin.host / FEATURE_ROLE_CONFLICT`. The output's `defaultFormat` applies only when no explicit formatter survives.

blocks.text: Batch defaults are `maxSize: 20`, `maxWaitMs: 2000`, `maxConcurrentBatches: 1`, `maxPendingBatches: 1024` and `drainTimeoutMs: 3000`. Capacity counts queued and active batches. Overflow drops the oldest queued batch, or the incoming batch when every slot is active, and reports `BATCH_OVERFLOW` with `detail.dropped`. Output removal drains its final buffer before revoking the registration signal used for delivery.

Retry requires an explicit positive safe-integer attempts count. Backoff is milliseconds or a function receiving the failed attempt's index. Transport `retryable` controls repetition; `retryDelay` is captured through `beforeRetry` and takes precedence over ordinary backoff. Timeout failures report `DELIVERY_FAILED`, retaining the canonical utils timeout on cause.

When delivery fails and timeout cleanup also fails, `retryable` and `retryDelay` receive the original delivery error. Cleanup failures follow it in the original aggregate, retained on a `logging / DELIVERY_FAILED` wrapper's `cause`. Cleanup after successful delivery reports once through the same host error boundary and never replays the successful operation.

`deliver` receives readonly records and `{ signal, format }`. Each record carries native entry and selected text. `context.format` is the selected installed formatter implementation, rather than the cold feature token. Observe its formatter or optional pretty-rendering behavior instead of comparing token identity.

Set `consumesText: false` and omit `defaultFormat` for an entry-only output. Its callback receives records containing only `entry` and a context containing only `signal`. Host formatting is skipped for that output; configuring any output-local format throws `INVALID_OPTION` when the output is installed. Entry features, gates, batching, retry and timeout still apply. Omitting `consumesText` keeps the existing text callback types and required defaultFormat.

`defineLogPlugin` and `defineOutputPlugin` declare real native `features` records. Their optional `install(core)` reads native outputs through `core.features[alias]` and returns precisely inferred host and dynamic-handle extensions. Filter and threshold controls automatically use `${pluginName}_${alias}_${method}` names; plugin-host rejects duplicate complete extension names. Reusing a token never shares mutable state between plugin or host installations. A carrier control affects every output inheriting that carrier policy. The real core provides scoped config, lifecycle, scheduler, install-owned resources, sinks, failures, deferred work, flush and shutdown. Plugin-host retains rollback and resource ownership.

Use `defineLogFeature()` for a complete entry, gate or format implementation, for example `defineLogFeature({ phase: 'gate', accept: () => true })`. Delivery remains limited to built-in batch/retry/timeout factories. Every factory returns an opaque native `defineFeature` token without phase, stage, setLevel or add fields. The definition accepts no feature name; the record key supplies it. The phase and the built-in delivery policy are read from each feature's installed output, so phase and scope rules are checked when the declaring plugin is installed; native installation outputs own state and controls. Object literals, shallow copies and type assertions cannot manufacture plugin-host identity.

`projectLogEntry(entry)` replaces only error with utils `serializeErrorChain(entry.error.raw)`. Structured output retains source, code, name, message, stack, cause and aggregate branches while excluding raw private fields. JSON and HTTP use this same projection; the original native raw object remains unchanged.

Log methods and flush/shutdown contain runtime failures. Creation errors and configuration use/unUse rejection remain visible to callers. Without failure listeners the reporter receives the error directly. Listener failures report `HOOK_FAILED` with the original on cause. Reporter throws, hostile then getters and rejections remain contained without recursive reporting.

The default 3000 ms flush budget is a bounded wait, not proof of successful delivery. A deadline reports `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` and fulfills; late rejections remain observed. Shutdown shares one Promise and the first reason. Final-log handlers run before admission closes and plugins release. Inspect structured `cleanupErrors` when cleanup matters to the application.

`forwardPlugin({ targets })` forwards processed logical entries into target hosts' own pipelines and policies. Installation rejects self-links and multi-hop cycles as `FORWARD_SELF` and `FORWARD_CYCLE`. Source flush includes target asynchronous work.

`use(...plugins)` returns the canonical input-ordered handle tuple without changing the original variable's static extension type. `unUse(name)` returns the peer removal result; removing an absent registration rejects. Removing forward disconnects its edges. Source shutdown leaves target hosts alive.

blocks.text: `projectLogEntry(entry)` 是共享结构化投影。它只把 error 替换为 utils `serializeErrorChain(entry.error.raw)`；保留 source、code、name、message、stack、cause 与 aggregate 分支，排除 raw 的自有私有字段。JSON 格式与 HTTP envelope 共用该投影，原始 entry.error.raw 不变。
日志方法与 flush/shutdown 的运行期错误不会进入业务控制流；创建配置错误与 use/unUse 的配置拒绝仍可离开调用边界。没有失败监听器时直接调用 reporter；监听器失败产生 `HOOK_FAILED`，原异常在 cause。reporter 自身抛错、then getter 失败或拒绝均被收住，终端失败不再递归上报。
`flush()` 的 3000 毫秒默认预算不证明所有日志已经送达。到期报告 `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` 并兑现；未完成工作的晚到拒绝仍被观察。shutdown 共享同一个 Promise，保留第一个 reason，先运行允许写最后日志的处理器，再关闭准入并释放插件。释放结果中的 `cleanupErrors` 必须由业务按需要检查。
